resources.string: Keeps your remote\'s extra buttons working. remapd starts by itself whenever Shizuku starts, including after a restart, and whenever you open this app.
Shizuku: running, and this app may use it.

Shizuku: not running. Open it and start it, and turn on Start on boot there so it starts by itself after a restart.
Shizuku isn\'t installed. Install it first; thedjchi\'s version can start itself after a restart.
Shizuku: this version is too old. Update Shizuku.
remapd isn\'t in /data/local/tmp yet. Copy remapd and remapd.conf there with adb first.
There\'s no /data/local/tmp/remapd.conf yet. Copy your config there with adb first.
